info.name: DSQL inventory buckets
info.description: Run with load tests stopped. Set stock checks independent bucket values, zero, omitted buckets, repeated assignments and invalid input, then prepares all four buckets at ten. Each decrement folder consumes one unit. Examples are illustrative.

request.description: Set supplied bucket values exactly in one transaction. Accepts 1–4 distinct IDs (0–3), with integer remaining >= 0 up to 2147483647. Omitted buckets stay unchanged. Duplicate IDs return 400. No auth; stop load tests before changing stock.
